annotations.text: Three directions for the way into CoGra — landing, join, sign in. Same flow and components everywhere; what varies is where the door is and how loud the brand speaks. Every screen has a 'dark' toggle in its tweak row. People and photos are mock material; @mira stands in for the inviter.

OPEN DOOR (recommended)

The landing is the feed itself: reading needs no account, so the product greets you by showing itself. Join and sign-in are sheets over the read — you never leave what you were looking at.

Truest to the architecture and the most unusual first impression.
Tradeoff: the brand stays quiet, and there is no ceremonial 'moment' of arrival.

VOUCHED IN

A warm dedicated welcome, and joining led by the person vouching for you — their face first, the form second. The most human telling of invite-only.

Tradeoff: adds a screen the architecture does not need, and the most conventional of the three.

THE MARK

The app-tile colorway at screen scale: one orange block that stays identical in light and dark, then quiet type-led forms carrying a 4px orange thread.

Strongest identity from ten feet away.
Tradeoff: spends the loud surface (primaryContainer) on decoration, which the system otherwise reserves for compose and a committed stance — a deliberate rule stretch to decide on.
